title: Doctor reports one canonical-representation cause twice for a completion seal
outcome: Doctor reports one canonical-representation cause twice for a completion seal
acceptance: When a completion seal's canonical object does not survive being written back, integrity verification reports completion_seal:<id>:canonical_representation once per seal, keeping both seal checks as detectors: duplicates of that exact label are dropped at work-report assembly (first occurrence kept), and every other finding, their order and the checked count are unchanged

Tests pin it: the explicit-empty seal member matrix expects that label once (and the sqlite-store brief's table no longer says it is reported by both seal checks); the canonical-representation-vs-projection-drift test asserts exact count one for the seal's canonical label, including combined damage; a raw-byte canonical seal with a duplicate known field plus an explicit `obligations: []` still reports canonical_representation once together with the generic completion_seal:<id> label; two distinct corrupted seals each get one label; and a missing canonical object and a kind mismatch keep their own findings
